exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.purpose: compute the unchanged EOG first-passage support for many cross-fit source sets without repeating target-by-target matrix propagation
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.recurrence: H_t = Q @ H_(t-1), then set diag(H_t)=1 for t=1..max_steps
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.semantics: H_t[s,j] is cumulative first-passage support for target j from unit source s within t steps under the same sub-stochastic Q; this is algebraically equivalent to target-absorbing summarize_first_passage
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.multiple_source_support: equal-weight mean of source rows H_t[source_indices,:], with declared source-node columns set to 1.0 at every step to match WorldSetForecast source handling
exact_batch_first_passage_optimization.compatibility_target_rule: non-source occurrence target is supported iff the equal-weight final-step support is > support_tolerance=0
